findings.comment: The material field in the title block and Note N5 contain placeholder text ('#') instead of a specific material specification. This prevents the manufacturer from selecting the correct stock and verifying machinability or heat treatment requirements.
findings.recommended_correction: Replace the placeholder with the specific material standard and grade (e.g., 'Aluminum 6061-T6' or 'SS 304').
